meta.name: temple-generator
meta.description: Generate a 3D interactive knowledge map (Inner Temple) from any Obsidian vault or document set. Supports multi-scale abstraction layers and dual-graph common maps between two vaults.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 Obsidian 笔记生成 3D 交互知识图谱
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你用 Obsidian 管理知识并想以 3D 图谱探索笔记关联
copy.tagline_en: Generate a 3D interactive knowledge map from Obsidian notes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use Obsidian and want to explore note connections in 3D

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以将你的 Obsidian 知识库或文档集转化为一个 3D 交互式知识地图（Inner Temple），包含实体环、音频、发现机制和多尺度语义缩放，输出为单个 HTML 文件。
howto.when: 当你输入触发词 /temple-generate 并指定知识库路径时触发。也可通过 --compare 参数比较两个知识库。

say.text: 比较我的两个 Obsidian 库，生成双图知识地图。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can transform your Obsidian vault or document set into a 3D interactive knowledge map (Inner Temple) with concentric entity rings, audio, discovery mechanics, and multi-scale semantic zoom, output as a single HTML file.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you type /temple-generate and specify a vault path. Optionally use --compare to compare two vaults.

say_en.text: Use /temple-generate to turn my Obsidian vault into a 3D map.
say_en.note: Claude will scan the vault and generate an HTML file.

say_en.text: Compare my two Obsidian vaults and generate a dual-graph knowledge map.
say_en.note: Using --compare, Claude will produce shared and unique analysis.
